mainEntity.name: When should a home service business consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization?

acceptedAnswer.text: A home service business should consider investing in Answer Engine Optimization when they want to increase their visibility beyond traditional search rankings, especially in an era dominated by voice search and AI-powered answers. If your target customers frequently ask direct questions about services, pricing, or local providers, AEO can position your business as the direct authority. It's particularly beneficial if you're looking to capture leads from 'near me' searches and establish your brand as a trusted source of information, rather than just another website in a list of results.
acceptedAnswer.description: A home service business should invest in AEO when aiming to increase visibility in voice search and AI-powered answers, especially for direct customer queries and 'near me' searches.
